title: Confluence-Jira gap bridge inventory (ad-hoc tracker)
content:
Purpose: quick ad-hoc inventory to map obvious documentation gaps between Confluence pages (~customer-facing runbooks / internal runbooks) and active Jira tickets. Goal is to have a minimal set of owners + quick mitigations so on-call / SWEs have something to use until documentation PRs land.

How to use: update rows as you triage tickets. If you are assigned as owner for a Jira ticket, please add your initials and estimated write time. Sync cadence: weekly quick review on Mondays during platform-ops async check (5–10m).

Columns: Confluence page | Short gap description | Affected Jira ticket(s) | Assigned owner | Priority (P0/P1/P2) | Quick-est (hrs) | Proposed temporary mitigation / snippet | Notes / next step (PR / reviewer)

1) infra-fallback-policy (confluence) | missing granular fallback sequences for model routing when Dedicated pool signals OOM vs node unavailability | PLAT-1987, PLAT-1991 | Marcus Lee | P0 | 4h | Add prioritized list: region failover -> model-variant fallback -> rate-limit throttle; paste sequence into incident-runbook temp section | Marcus to draft snippet; PR to platform-docs repo; need review from SRE

2) serving-runtime/kv-cache-behavior | no example showing KV cache warm-up impact on cold-start latency numbers | PLAT-2034 | Priya Nair | P1 | 2h | Add short note: observed 80–120ms cold penalty on p3x8 for first 5k tokens; include command to pre-warm cache during canary | Priya to attach perf traces; link to benchmark PR

3) private-deployments/networking-guide | ambiguous firewall example for common KMS flows (customer question in sales thread) | PLAT-2010 | Diego Cruz | P1 | 3h | Add 2 sample iptables rules and KMS endpoint whitelist example; temporary: refer customers to support snippet in slack 

4) dedicated/throughput-tuning | missing recommended batch_size heuristics per model family (Llama style vs transformer-xl) | PLAT-2056 | Ava Chen | P2 | 6h | Paste recommended table from internal notes; short script to compute batch_size from p99 latency target | Need input from Applied ML on quantized profiles

5) console-and-rollouts/rollout-fallbacks | rollout policy matrix lacks guidance on telemetry thresholds that trigger automated fallback | PLAT-2080, PLAT-2081 | Marcus Lee | P0 | 5h | Insert metric thresholds (error_rate > 3%, token_latency > 2x baseline for 5m) + sample Grafana alert rule | Marcus to coordinate with observability; inline alert example needed

6) optimize/model-quant-guides | quick reference missing for 4-bit quantization caveats per HW | PLAT-2105 | Priya Nair | P2 | 3h | Add callouts: incompatible kernels, accuracy drop notes, and recommended regression eval prompts | Link to quant pilot notes (internal)

7) private-deployments/onprem-install | runbook step 3 (service account creation) has outdated IAM bindings | PLAT-1999 | Diego Cruz | P1 | 1h | Add current terraform snippet and a note about least-privilege role change | Diego to push small terraform commit to repo

Open questions / triage heuristics:
- If multiple Jira tickets cover the same Confluence gap, pick the highest-priority ticket as the primary owner and reference the others.
- Use P0 when the gap blocks incident response or customer SLA handoffs.
- Quick-est is for the documentation authoring work only (not the underlying engineering fix).

Temporary snippets repo (placeholders):
- infra-fallback-sequence: "1) fail region; 2) switch to model-variant B (quantized); 3) enable rate limiter for route X"
- sample iptables snippet: "-A INPUT -p tcp --dport 443 -s 10.0.0.0/8 -j ACCEPT"

Action items (next 7 days):
- Marcus: draft infra-fallback-policy snippet and open PR in platform-docs (target: 2026-04-20)
- Priya: attach KV cache perf traces and draft short example (target: 2026-04-19)
- Diego: update onprem IAM snippet and push terraform commit (target: 2026-04-18)
- Ava: collate model family batch heuristics and request applied-ml review (target: 2026-04-22)

Meeting notes / decisions so far:
- 2026-04-14 quick sync: agreed to mark PLAT-1987 and PLAT-2080 as P0s; Marcus will own both for doc updates.
- 2026-04-15 slack thread (#platform-ops): support team will start using the "temporary mitigation" snippets for customer responses; note to convert accepted snippets into canonical runbook sections.

Tracker housekeeping:
- If you complete a doc update, add the Confluence page URL and the platform-docs PR link in the linked_artifacts list.
- Remove rows only after PRs are merged and the Confluence page has the new content.

Notes to self: this is intentionally lightweight — do not try to over-document here. The point is immediate triage and temporary mitigations for cross-team handoffs. Revisit for consolidation after 2–3 sprint cycles.

Last sync: 2026-04-18 by Ava Chen
